title: Use Seedance 2.0 with only reference images as input to generate alternative…
content: Use Seedance 2.0 with only reference images as input to generate alternative camera angles for a clip (no reference video needed).
tips: Use Seedance 2.0 with only reference images as input to generate alternative camera angles for a clip (no reference video needed).
